units.source_text: 梦幻的金阁在黑暗的金阁之上，依然清晰可见。

en.t: The phantom Golden Pavilion remained clearly visible above the Golden Pavilion in the darkness.

units.source_text: 它的灿烂辉煌没有终了。

en.t: Its dazzling radiance had no end.

units.source_text: 池畔的法水院的栏杆的确谦虚地后退了，

en.t: The railing of Hosui-in by the pond had indeed drawn back modestly,

units.source_text: 屋檐下用天竺式的肘托木支撑着的潮音洞的栏杆，容易做梦似地向池面探出自己的胸膛。

en.t: while the railing of Choon-do, supported beneath the eaves by Indian-style bracket arms, seemed ready, as if dreaming, to lean its own breast out toward the surface of the pond.
